newsitem.title: USA: AT&T stock slides 4 pct in post-results gloom.
newsitem.headline: AT&T stock slides 4 pct in post-results gloom.

text.p: AT&T stock slid 1-3/8 to 31-5/8 by 1130 EDT/1530 GMT in moderate volume on renewed selling after disappointing first quarter results on Monday.

Analysts said that investors may wait a while before picking up the stock as a bargain, because of the competitive brawl in AT&T's industry and the costs of preparing for entry into new markets which are both bedeviling its earnings.
"AT&T is having trouble in the core business and it will be at least a quarter before we can see where the turnaround point will be," said Guy Woodlief of Prudential Research.
AT&T's shares, adjusted for the spin-offs of Lucent Technologies Corp and NCR Corp are now trading at levels not seen since 1993.
"It has to be getting close to the bottom now," said Woodlief.

Though the four percent dividend yield should soon begin to prop up the shares, analysts note that AT&T's own actions are only half the story -- it has to respond to competitors in an industry where prices are hard to stabilize.
"As they say on the street 'Never try to catch a falling knife'," Woodlief said.
